project: TWIN-GRID (two offset candidate grids for budget-matched sparse attention; = g2_fill_v1 = +g2f)
plan: docs/EXPERIMENT_PLANS_ZH.md v1.4 frozen (machine-readable copy; the document is authoritative if they ever differ). Arm status 'ready' means the code path exists; it does NOT mean validated on the target model or against an official baseline implementation.

3.note: tier 3 runs the whole primary cell: primary pair, both Holm members (same runs) and the P-gain scorers

sample_rule: n = primary_cell.samples (100) for the exact primary cell (model, length, budget); otherwise tier.samples_other; predictions use frozen line numbers 0..n-1
pinned_ruler_sources_note: sha256 of the RULER files the pipeline reads, after applying docs/ruler_template_qwen.diff

protocol.argv_values_note: an absent flag means the ruler_pred default, which equals the value listed here; --layout-unit 32 puts the sink, the tail start and the candidate token budget on the 32-token grid for every block length (G3 matching: B = 16 arms read the same fixed tokens and candidate token count as B = 32)

secondary_family_note: Holm over exactly these two members (reviewer batch 2, U2). A third element names a registered task subset: 'coverable' = tasks whose every evaluated unit has length <= B/2+1 under coverage_rule, computed from the frozen unit-length file (cluster/unit_lengths.py) before aggregation.

coverage_rule.rule: task coverable iff max unit length over evaluated samples (frozen lines 0..n-1) <= block//2 + 1; no_unit tasks: cwe, fwe, qa_1, qa_2
coverage_rule.binding: per-task data sha256 == prep manifest; tokenizer.json sha256[:16] == prediction manifests' model:tokenizer.json; block and local == the compared arms'

registered_descriptive.P-gain: gain law (docs/THEORY_ZH.md): per scorer s in {cobs, nf_pt1, quest32} and unit task t, predicted Delta = pi_t * G_cf(s,t); pooled calibration ratio kappa = sum Delta / sum pi*G_cf with G cross-fitted on line-parity folds, auxiliary slope, pooled R by unit class (repair / out); sample-level stratified bootstrap with folds redone inside each resample (cluster/gain_law.py)
registered_descriptive.P-cov: cobs+g2f vs cobs by task group (coverable / not_coverable / no_unit): gain > 0 on coverable, ~0 elsewhere; interaction descriptive
registered_descriptive.quest32: quest32+g2f vs quest32 magnitude ~ pi*G (expected near 0); reported against the P-gain prediction, not as a detection test
registered_descriptive.P-grid: cobs16 vs cobs+g2f (equal summary memory, single vs joint selection; theory L4) after G3 layout matching; descriptive
registered_descriptive.other: em vs quest32; cobs+ptr vs cobs; quest16 vs quest16+g2f: descriptive
registered_descriptive.P-asym: per baseline scorer, failure rate of repair units whose grid-0 cut falls inside the value (0 < rv < vlen: 'value cut') vs before the value (rv = vlen: 'only the key cut'); a descriptive reading only, NOT a test of the read requirement R (the two groups differ in content, so a non-uniform fraction model also predicts an asymmetry); origin: post hoc on the local data (src/kv_residual.py, T5; reviewer batch 3 W1); computed by cluster/gain_law.py

acceptance.tie_rule: cluster/accept_tie_diag.py + cluster/accept_ties.py: (a) input tokens and official scores equal; (b) first-divergence reference top-2 margin <= 2*ulp_bf16(max|l|); (c) top-2 swap; (d) <= 1 tie per task and ties <= floor(0.02 * rows)
